request: Update the planner so that during revisions it must adapt its plan based on previous execution failures. If a run_command step fails, the planner must modify or replace that step instead of repeating it. It should analyze the failure and generate a new approach (e.g., fix the test, adjust the command, or remove invalid validation). Prevent identical plans across revisions.
title: Enhance planner to adapt plans based on execution failures
goals: Implement logic for the planner to analyze execution failures and adapt plans accordingly
Ensure the planner modifies or replaces failed run_command steps instead of repeating them
Develop a mechanism to prevent identical plans across revisions
constraints: Do not introduce changes that affect the overall architecture of the planner
Ensure backward compatibility with existing planner functionalities
success_criteria: The planner successfully adapts plans by modifying or replacing failed steps in at least 90% of test cases
Identical plans are not generated across revisions in any test cases
The planner maintains its original functionality without regression issues
